findings.summary: Traceability Gap: Milestone M2 lacks regression verification for core requirements R1, R2, and R3, despite the audit sample explicitly mapping these requirements to this milestone.

evidence.note: Milestone M2 Exit Criteria only include tests for new tag features (AT11, AT12, AT13) and lack regression tests for input discovery (R1/AT1), static output (R2/AT2), and note page generation (R3/AT3), contrary to the audit sample which traces these requirements to M2.
evidence.quote: ["AT11 passes: tags extracted per configured convention...", "AT12 passes: each tag on a note page links...", "AT13 passes: tags index page lists all tags..."]

evidence.note: Milestone M2 deliverables modify the note page generation defined in R3 (by injecting tags via DL8) but do not explicitly cite R3 or R1/R2 as active requirements for this phase.

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R1 maps the requirement to milestones ["M1","M2"], but the plan’s explicit R1 delivery work is in M1; M2 deliverables do not mention Markdown file discovery. This looks like an over-broad or inaccurate milestone trace in the sample check.

evidence.note: Sample check milestone mapping for R1 includes M2
M1 includes recursive .md file discovery explicitly tied to R1 (DL2)
evidence.quote: Recursive .md file discovery from the input directory (R1)

evidence.note: M2 deliverables are tags-focused and do not reference file discovery / R1

findings.summary: Deterministic sample check for R2 maps the requirement to milestones ["M1","M2"], but the plan’s explicit R2 delivery work is in M1; M2 deliverables do not mention static-only output constraints. This looks like an over-broad or inaccurate milestone trace in the sample check.

evidence.note: Sample check milestone mapping for R2 includes M2
M1 includes static site output directory deliverable tied to R2 (DL4)
evidence.quote: Static site output directory containing one HTML page per note plus minimal CSS (R2)

evidence.note: M2 deliverables are tags-focused and do not reference static-only output / R2

findings.summary: R3/AT3 require the ability to exclude a Markdown file via configuration ("not explicitly excluded by configuration"; AT3 procedure uses an exclusion config), but M1 deliverables (where AT3 is an M1 exit criterion) do not include any exclusion/config capability. Exclusion appears later as M5 DL23 (R20 SHOULD). This creates a trace inconsistency: either M1 must deliver minimal exclusion/config to satisfy AT3/R3, or AT3/M1 exit criteria need adjustment.

evidence.note: R3 references exclusion by configuration
evidence.quote: generate a corresponding HTML page for every input Markdown file not explicitly excluded by configuration.

evidence.note: AT3 explicitly depends on a configuration that excludes one Markdown file
evidence.quote: Prepare a fixture with N Markdown files (N>=3) and a configuration that excludes one specific Markdown file.

evidence.note: M1 exit criteria includes AT3 passing
evidence.quote: AT3 passes: one-to-one mapping of non-excluded .md files to HTML pages

evidence.note: M1 deliverables list does not include any exclusion/config feature needed by AT3/R3
Exclusion is deferred to M5 as a SHOULD (DL23 / R20 SHOULD), conflicting with AT3 in M1
evidence.quote: File/directory exclusion via configuration or CLI option (R20 SHOULD)
